meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把图片转成结构化文字,让看不见图的模型也能读懂图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用的模型看不了图,却总要把图片内容读给它。
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into structured text so text-only models can read what's in a picture.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your model can't see images but you keep needing to feed it picture content.

howto.what: 当对话里出现图片路径、URL 或 [Image #1] 这类占位符，而模型看不到图时，它会调用 modlens CLI 把图转成结构化 JSON：逐字转录、版面区域、语义与视觉线索，供回答引用。
howto.when: 当对话里出现带图片扩展名的路径或 URL、[Image #1] 等占位符，或用户问如何安装、配置 modlens 时接管；若模型已能直接看到图片则不使用。

howto.what_en: When an image path, URL, or placeholder like [Image #1] appears and the model can't see it, it runs the modlens CLI to turn the image into structured JSON evidence: transcription, layout, semantics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a path or URL with an image extension or an [Image #1]-style placeholder appears, or when the user asks to install, configure, or switch modlens providers.
